acceptanceCriteria: Retain a regression or documented invocation witness for CORVINT_BIN set to a PATH-only command name versus an explicit executable path at the same source/version; preserve original verifier-unavailable refusal and passing default checker evidence.

Either resolve the selected PATH executable consistently before passing override-verifier, or document/refuse the unsupported form at the executable-selection boundary with an actionable message; do not weaken canonical verification, version identity, or BASE/current agreement.

Keep reviewer-reproduction issue V1-0182 distinct: this observation already had complete reports and valid bindings. Focused wrapper/doc evidence and independent review must match the eventual selected remedy.
body: Observed workflow friction, not a demonstrated CEM correctness defect. On macOS/Go1.27.1, Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163 / Tasks build202, dispatcher468 bind5565697748a56c285a2e30d747a05d70c04d0df3 with BASE0b6bbe062f7f0274941a38ad003f9820c8112774 had four passing keyed checks, reviewed reports, and strict finish SATISFIED. Running CORVINT_BIN=corvint make dogfood-check BASE=0b6... accepted the PATH executable version in script/dogfood-check.sh but later returned dogfood-check: REFUSE verifier-unavailable. The wrapper passes bare corvint as --override-verifier. Running the same repository default current-tree path without CORVINT_BIN passed; make dogfood-seal also passed. Repro log /private/tmp/dispatch-468-terminal-postcommit-CHECK.log; successful control /private/tmp/dispatch-468-terminal-postcommit-CHECK-NATIVE.log. Dedup searches agent-memory+CORVINT_BIN and override-verifier found V1-0182 (completed, fresh-clone report-missing issue) and V1-0567 (empty range); neither owns this selection/late-diagnostic friction. Expected boundary should consistently resolve supported executable selection or reject/document an unsupported PATH-only override before unnecessary checker builds. The intended support policy is not inferred; choosing the smallest supported remedy is part of the ticket. No source fix, qualification promotion, release update, or passing absolute-path override witness is claimed by this filing. Default path removed the current delivery blocker. Freshness UNKNOWN remains from the existing updater process-snapshot issue; build labels are not release qualification.
title: Dogfood: resolve or clarify PATH-only CORVINT_BIN before late verifier-unavailable refusal
